description: This file defines the SerializationConstructorFactory class responsible for creating and managing delegates that invoke ISerializable-conformant constructors, using reflection and dynamic method generation within the Orleans.Serialization namespace.

classes.name: SerializationConstructorFactory
classes.description: A factory class creating delegates for invoking serialization constructors, primarily utilizing reflection and dynamic code emission to generate efficient constructor invokers.

methods.name: HasSerializationConstructor
methods.description: Checks whether a given type has a suitable serialization constructor.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate
methods.description: Returns a delegate for constructing an object from serialization info for a specific type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate<TOwner, TConstructor>
methods.description: Generic method to obtain a serialization constructor delegate for a specific owner type and delegate type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a constructor delegate for a specific owner type and delegate type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructor
methods.description: Retrieves the ConstructorInfo for the serialization constructor of a type, if present.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorInvoker
methods.description: Generates a delegate that invokes the serialization constructor using Reflection.Emit, with custom IL code.
